rv.q: Despite his efforts it was still difficult to let the opening twenty minutes cast their spell as ushers were letting a continuous stream of people in, groping nervously and distractingly through the dim lighting, scared of the terrifying drop before them.
Between the heartwrung, soulful voice, big doleful eyes, and occasional snarls of bitterness, Knight effectively suggests this is one pussycat who has failed to land on her feet.

cn.t: Critics find this revival of Lloyd Webber's musical overlong and showing its age, particularly in the choreography, though individual performances like Beverley Knight's offer some appeal.
